$comment: Baseline risk register for Sim-Roaster, identified from the codebase on 2026-05-10. Scores are computed (likelihood x impact) by scripts and the app; they are not stored here. Owners are role titles until named individuals are assigned. Source for docs/risk-register.md (node scripts/risk/gen-register-md.mjs) and for the Admin 'Import baseline' action.

risks.title: Scheduling rules are enforced only in the browser
risks.description: Eligibility, leave, training and qualification checks run client-side. The server accepts any well-formed snapshot from a user with edit permission.
risks.cause: evaluateAssignment() is imported only by UI components; PUT /api/state validates snapshot shape and permission, not assignment rules.
risks.consequence: A modified client, script or stale tab can save assignments that the rules would block (unqualified, on leave, double-booked).

evidence.note: Server-side checks are permission + zod shape validation

existingControls.description: Hash-chained audit diff of every snapshot write (detective)

risks.treatmentPlan: Run evaluateAssignment server-side for every changed assignment in PUT /api/state and reject blocked seats unless manualOverride and a non-empty overrideReason are present.

risks.title: Expired position validity only produces a warning
risks.description: A staff member whose validity for a position has expired can still be assigned without override.
risks.cause: assignment-eval.ts pushes 'Position validity expired' to warnings, not blocks.
risks.consequence: Non-current staff deliver simulator sessions; regulatory or training-quality non-compliance.

existingControls.description: Warning badge shown in assignment popovers

risks.treatmentPlan: Operations Manager to confirm policy. If expired validity must not be scheduled, move it to blocks so it requires manual override with reason (and enforce server-side via R-001).

risks.title: Eligibility rules read static reference data, not live store data
risks.description: evaluateAssignment reads staff qualifications and position/exercise qualification rules from the bundled sample-data module.
risks.cause: lib/assignment-eval.ts imports * as seed from ./sample-data and reads seed.staffQualifications, seed.positionQualRules and seed.exerciseQualRules.
risks.consequence: If qualifications or rules are edited in the app, eligibility checks may use outdated data and allow or block the wrong people. Not yet confirmed whether these lists are editable at runtime.

evidence.note: Static import of sample-data used for rule evaluation

existingControls.description: Callers pass isOperational from the live staff profile

risks.treatmentPlan: Confirm whether these lists are runtime-editable. If so, pass live store lookups into evaluateAssignment and add a test that an edited rule changes the outcome.

risks.title: Manual override bypasses assignment blocks
risks.description: Managers can override hard blocks; the reason parameter is optional in the store API.
risks.cause: assignStaff(runId, positionId, staffId, override?, reason?) accepts override without enforcing a reason server-side.
risks.consequence: Ineligible staff assigned with no justification, discovered only after the session.

evidence.note: override and reason are optional parameters

existingControls.description: Audit diff records the changed assignment

risks.treatmentPlan: Require a non-empty override reason server-side; add a periodic override report for the Operations Manager.

risks.title: Leave recorded after assignment may not flag existing seats
risks.description: Leave is checked when an assignment is made. It has not been verified that existing assignments are re-flagged when leave is added later.
risks.cause: isOnLeave() is evaluated at assignment time (lib/store.tsx:1131, :1345); no revalidation path was found.
risks.consequence: Staff on leave remain rostered; session uncovered on the day.
risks.treatmentPlan: Verify behaviour; if confirmed, add a conflict report listing assignments that overlap leave, shown on the dashboard.

risks.title: All operational data lives in one JSON document
risks.description: Every domain entity is stored in the single Blob object sim-roster/state.json and written as a whole document.
risks.cause: Original persistence design; Postgres migration designed but not cut over.
risks.consequence: A single bad write, corrupt document or schema drift affects all data at once; no referential integrity.
risks.treatmentPlan: Complete the relational cutover described in docs/data-architecture-migration.md.

risks.title: Restore overwrites live data without an automatic safety backup
risks.description: POST /api/backup/restore replaces the live snapshot; taking a pre-restore backup is a manual runbook step.
risks.cause: Restore route does not snapshot current state first.
risks.consequence: Restoring the wrong backup permanently loses changes made since the last backup.

existingControls.description: Restore is Admin-only and fail-closed audited
Runbook requires a manual pre-restore backup

risks.treatmentPlan: Make the restore route write a pre-restore backup and refuse to proceed if that write fails.

risks.title: Backups share the live Blob store and token
risks.description: Backups are written under sim-roster/backups/ in the same store, using the same BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN as live data.
risks.cause: Single Blob store configured for the project.
risks.consequence: Store deletion, account loss or token compromise destroys live data and every backup together.
risks.treatmentPlan: Schedule an off-platform copy (separate account or provider, separate credentials) and verify it monthly.

risks.title: Recovery objectives (RTO/RPO) are not approved
risks.description: Recommended RTO/RPO values exist, but every approved value is null.
risks.cause: Approval by the business owner not yet obtained.
risks.consequence: Backup frequency and recovery effort are not tied to an agreed tolerance; recovery expectations may be unmet.
risks.treatmentPlan: Owner approves RTO/RPO; run and record a restore drill against the approved values.

risks.title: Hosting, cron and storage depend on a single platform
risks.description: Application hosting, the nightly backup cron and Blob storage all run on Vercel.
risks.cause: Platform choice.
risks.consequence: A platform outage or account suspension stops the app and scheduled backups simultaneously.
risks.treatmentPlan: Proposed for acceptance: tolerate platform dependency, relying on off-platform backups (R-008). Requires owner approval before status becomes accepted.

risks.title: Postgres outage blocks all audited writes
risks.description: Audited operations fail closed: if the audit insert cannot be written the change is refused. Auth sessions also depend on Postgres.
risks.cause: Deliberate fail-closed design of withAudit().
risks.consequence: During a database outage no scheduling changes can be saved and users cannot sign in.

evidence.note: Throws AuditUnavailableError before the operation runs

risks.treatmentPlan: Proposed for acceptance: integrity of the audit trail is preferred over write availability. Requires owner approval.

risks.title: Known advisories in the dependency tree
risks.description: pnpm audit on 2026-05-10 reported 1 critical, 27 high, 33 moderate and 6 low advisories, largely transitive (e.g. undici, hono, js-yaml, brace-expansion, postcss). Exploitability in this app has not been assessed.
risks.cause: No automated dependency update or audit gate.
risks.consequence: Exploitable library flaws could enable denial of service, header injection or worse.
risks.treatmentPlan: Triage the critical/high advisories for reachability, upgrade direct dependencies, enable Dependabot or Renovate, and add an audit step to CI.

risks.title: No automated test suite; 24 TypeScript errors
risks.description: package.json has build and lint scripts only and no test files exist. tsc --noEmit reports 24 errors.
risks.cause: Tests not yet written; type errors tolerated.
risks.consequence: Regressions in scheduling rules or persistence reach users undetected.

existingControls.description: ESLint; manual type-error baseline tracked during changes

risks.treatmentPlan: Add unit tests for evaluateAssignment and route tests for /api/state; fix the 24 type errors.

risks.title: Builds ignore TypeScript errors
risks.description: next.config.mjs sets typescript.ignoreBuildErrors: true, so type-broken code can deploy.
risks.cause: Flag set to unblock builds while type errors exist.
risks.consequence: Defective deployment reaches production; outage or incorrect behaviour until rollback.

existingControls.description: Preview deployments and Vercel instant rollback

risks.treatmentPlan: Fix the type errors (R-013) and remove ignoreBuildErrors; require a passing type-check before merge.

risks.title: No multi-factor authentication; weak passwords allowed in demo-seed mode
risks.description: Better Auth is configured for email + password only. Minimum password length is 12, but 5 when demo seeding is enabled.
risks.cause: lib/auth.ts: minPasswordLength: demoSeed ? 5 : 12; no two-factor plugin.
risks.consequence: Credential stuffing or phishing gives full access, including to Admin accounts.

existingControls.description: Better Auth password hashing and session management
Auth rate limiting (100 req / 60 s with custom rules)

risks.treatmentPlan: Enable two-factor authentication for Admin accounts; confirm demo seeding is disabled in production.

risks.title: API rate limiting is per serverless instance
risks.description: The API rate limiter keeps counters in process memory, so limits are not shared across instances.
risks.cause: In-memory Map store in lib/security/rate-limit.ts.
risks.consequence: Brute-force or scraping traffic spread across instances exceeds intended limits.

existingControls.description: Per-instance limits plus Better Auth limits on auth endpoints

risks.treatmentPlan: Move the limiter store to a shared backend (e.g. Upstash Redis).

risks.title: Content Security Policy is report-only
risks.description: CSP is sent as Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only, so it logs violations but blocks nothing.
risks.cause: Initial rollout setting; Next.js inline scripts need a nonce before enforcement.
risks.consequence: No CSP protection if an XSS flaw is introduced.
risks.treatmentPlan: Introduce nonce-based script-src and switch to an enforced Content-Security-Policy.

risks.title: Single Admin can change permissions and restore or delete data
risks.description: The role-permission matrix is stored in the snapshot and read by server authorization. One Admin can change it, restore backups or delete backups without a second approver.
risks.cause: No dual control on privileged actions.
risks.consequence: A compromised or mistaken Admin account can escalate privileges or destroy data.

existingControls.description: Matrix changes captured in audit diff; audit is Admin-only and append-only

risks.treatmentPlan: Quarterly access review of Admin accounts; consider two-person approval for restore and backup deletion.

risks.title: Database credentials can disable audit protections
risks.description: The application connects with credentials that can alter schema, so someone holding DATABASE_URL could drop the append-only triggers.
risks.cause: Single database role used for app and migrations; env vars readable by project members.
risks.consequence: Audit records could be altered or truncated by a privileged insider.

evidence.note: Same connection string used for app and DDL

existingControls.description: Hash-chain verification (/api/audit/verify) detects altered or removed interior rows

risks.treatmentPlan: Create a least-privilege runtime role without DDL rights; periodically export the chain head hash off-platform.

risks.title: Email notifications depend on Resend
risks.description: Staff notifications are sent via Resend. If NOTIFY_FROM_EMAIL is unset the sender defaults to onboarding@resend.dev.
risks.cause: Single email provider; default sender fallback.
risks.consequence: Outage or misconfiguration means staff are not told about schedule changes.

evidence.note: Resend client and default from address

risks.treatmentPlan: Set NOTIFY_FROM_EMAIL to a verified domain in production; surface send failures to the sender.

risks.title: Test-data endpoint can create users and data
risks.description: POST /api/autonoma seeds auth users and domain data into the live snapshot for end-to-end tests, protected by a signing secret.
risks.cause: Third-party test tooling endpoint deployed with the app.
risks.consequence: If the signing secret leaks, an attacker could create accounts or inject data.
risks.treatmentPlan: Disable the endpoint in production (allow only preview environments) and rotate the secret periodically.

risks.title: Destructive administrative actions are single-step
risks.description: Restore, backup deletion and bulk run cancellation are performed by one person after a confirmation dialog.
risks.cause: No staged or reversible execution for destructive operations.
risks.consequence: Wrong backup restored or wrong runs cancelled.

existingControls.description: Fail-closed audit on restore and delete

risks.treatmentPlan: Automatic pre-restore backup (R-007); typed confirmation for restore and deletion.

risks.title: Incorrect scheduling data entry
risks.description: Wrong dates, positions, qualifications or leave entered by schedulers.
risks.cause: Manual data entry under time pressure.
risks.consequence: Sessions mis-staffed or staff double-booked.

existingControls.description: Assignment blocks and warnings in the UI
Audit diff allows tracing and correction

risks.treatmentPlan: Scheduler training; weekly pre-publication review of the coming week's roster.

risks.title: Legacy client-writable audit log could be mistaken for the authoritative record
risks.description: The snapshot still carries an auditLogs slice written by the browser.
risks.cause: Pre-existing client-side audit feature.
risks.consequence: Investigations relying on it could be misled by forged entries.

existingControls.description: Labelled legacy in the Admin UI; server audit trail is authoritative

risks.treatmentPlan: Remove the slice after the relational cutover.

risks.title: Unauthenticated or under-privileged API access
risks.description: API routes reachable without a session or with insufficient role.
risks.cause: Route handlers previously lacked consistent authorization.
risks.consequence: Data disclosure or modification by unauthenticated users.

evidence.note: Session gate and per-route authorization; runtime check returned 307 for unauthenticated requests

existingControls.description: authorize() with role/permission and CSRF origin check on every route

risks.treatmentPlan: Implemented. Keep: every new route must call authorize().

risks.title: Lost updates from concurrent snapshot writes
risks.description: Two users saving the whole snapshot could silently overwrite each other's changes.
risks.cause: Whole-document persistence.
risks.consequence: Assignments or leave silently reverted.

existingControls.description: If-Match revision precondition; autosave stops on conflict

risks.treatmentPlan: Implemented.

risks.title: Changes not attributable to a person
risks.description: Without a server-side trail, misuse of legitimate access could not be traced.
risks.cause: Previously only a client-side audit log existed.
risks.consequence: Inability to investigate or demonstrate accountability.

existingControls.description: Admin-only viewer, verification and CSV export

risks.treatmentPlan: Implemented. Residual privileged-database risk tracked in R-019.

risks.title: AI-assisted code changes
risks.description: The application has no runtime AI features (no AI SDK dependency). The codebase is developed with AI assistance (v0 branches, AGENTS.md).
risks.cause: Generated code may contain subtle defects or security regressions.
risks.consequence: Defects or weakened controls merged without detection.

evidence.ref: package.json (no ai/@ai-sdk deps); branch v0/security-hardening; AGENTS.md

existingControls.description: Branch-based changes with pull requests (human review not verified)

risks.treatmentPlan: Require human review of every AI-generated PR plus the test and type-check gates from R-013/R-014.

risks.title: Schema changes applied by ad-hoc scripts without a migration ledger
risks.description: SQL migrations are applied by standalone scripts; the database does not record which migrations have run.
risks.cause: No migration tracking table or runner.
risks.consequence: Environments drift; a migration is skipped or applied out of order.

evidence.note: Reads and executes one SQL file directly

existingControls.description: Idempotent SQL with matching down scripts

risks.treatmentPlan: Introduce a schema_migrations ledger and a single runner script.
